_comment: gmail-inbox-manager ruleset template.
FORMAT
Each rule is an object with:
name              human-readable category name (used in the digest)
label             the Gmail label applied to matching mail
archive           true  -> label + remove INBOX (mail stays in All Mail,
fully reversible).
false -> label + KEEP in inbox
match.from_contains     list of case-insensitive substrings matched
against the full From header
match.subject_contains  list of case-insensitive substrings matched
against the Subject line
Within one rule ANY from_contains OR ANY subject_contains entry hits.
Rules are evaluated TOP TO BOTTOM and the FIRST match wins — so put
narrow rules above broad ones.
THE LAST RULE MUST BE THE CATCH-ALL: empty from_contains and
empty subject_contains, and archive=false. That rule is what an
unknown/unmatched sender lands on.
DEFAULT SAFETY RULE
'never archive unknown senders'. The catch-all rule has archive=false,
so anything the script does not recognise is labelled with the
fallback_label (default 'Unsorted') and STAYS in the inbox. The script
refuses to start if the catch-all rule has archive=true.
LABEL CREATION
Labels listed here are created automatically ONLY if their exact name
is in the config key 'approved_labels'. Run --dry-run first to see
which labels would be new, then approve them.
NOTE
Every sender below is a clearly-marked EXAMPLE placeholder. Replace
them with your own real senders and subjects before going live.

subject_contains: signed in on a new device
